name: Mass Invisibility
description: You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 12 sec. Taking any action will cancel the effect.\n\nDoes not affect allies in combat.

name: Greater Invisibility
description: Makes you invisible and untargetable for 20 sec, removing all threat. Any action taken cancels this effect.

name: Mirror Image
description: Creates 3 copies of you nearby for 15 sec, which cast spells and attack your enemies. While active, you generate significantly reduced threat.\n\nTaking direct damage will cause one of your images to dissipate.

name: Arcane Surge
description:
Expend all of your current mana to annihilate your enemy target and nearby enemies for up to 3,740 Arcane damage based on Mana spent. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

For the next 15 sec, your Mana regeneration is increased by 425% and spell damage is increased by 35%.

Generates Clearcasting.

name: Alter Time
description: Alters the fabric of time, returning you to your current location and health when cast a second time, or after 10 sec. Effect negated by long distance or death.

name: Arcane Pulse
description: A pulse of Arcane magic erupts from underneath your target, dealing 2,474 Arcane damage to all enemies within 8 yds. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.\n\nGenerates 1 Arcane Charge for each enemy struck.

name: Remove Curse
description: Removes all Curses from a friendly target.

name: Touch of the Magi
description: Applies Touch of the Magi to your current target, accumulating 20% of the damage you deal to the target for 12 sec, and then exploding for that amount of Arcane damage to the target and reduced damage to all nearby enemies.\n\nGenerates 4 Arcane Charges.

name: Arcane Missiles
description: Requires Clearcasting\nLaunches 5 waves of Arcane Missiles at the enemy over 2.2 sec, causing a total of 2,147 Arcane damage.

name: Arcane Orb
description: Launches an Arcane Orb forward from your position, traveling up to 40 yds, dealing 1,213 Arcane damage to enemies it passes through.\n\nGrants 1 Arcane Charge when cast and every time it deals damage.

name: Ice Block
description: Encases you in a block of ice, protecting you from all attacks and damage for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.\n\nCauses Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 30 sec.

name: Prismatic Barrier
description: Shields you with an arcane force, absorbing 9,165 damage and reducing magic damage taken by 15% for 1 min.\n\nThe duration of harmful Magic effects against you is reduced by 25%.

name: Spellsteal
description: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min.

name: Mass Polymorph
description: Transforms all enemies within 10 yards into sheep, wandering around incapacitated for 15 sec. While affected, the victims cannot take actions but will regenerate health very quickly. Damage will cancel the effect.\n\nOnly works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

name: Dragon's Breath
description: Enemies in a 12 yd cone in front of you take 278 Fire damage and are disoriented for 4 sec. Damage will cancel the effect.

name: Presence of Mind
description: Causes your next 2 Arcane Blasts to be instant cast.

name: Ring of Frost
description: Summons a Ring of Frost for 10 sec at the target location. Enemies entering the ring are incapacitated for 10 sec. Limit 10 targets.\n\nWhen the incapacitate expires, enemies are slowed by 65% for 4 sec.

name: Supernova
description: Pulses arcane energy around the target enemy or ally, dealing 174 Arcane damage to all enemies within 8 yds, and knocking them upward. A primary enemy target will take 100% increased damage.

name: Ice Nova
description: Causes a whirl of icy wind around the enemy, dealing 568 Frost damage to the target and all other enemies within 8 yds, freezing them in place for 2 sec. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

name: Shimmer

name: Evocation
description: Increases your mana regeneration by 1,500% for 2.7 sec.

name: Illusion

name: Invisibility

name: Time Warp

description: The critical strike damage of your spells is increased by 5%.

name: Charm of Medivh
description: Your Mastery is increased by 3%.

name: Concentrated Power
description: Arcane Missiles channels 20% faster.

name: Consortium's Bauble

name: Controlled Instincts

name: Energized Barriers
description: Casting your barrier removes all snare effects.

name: Energized Familiar
description: During Arcane Surge, your Arcane Familiar fires 4 bolts instead of 1.\n\nDamage from your Arcane Familiar has a 6% chance to restore 2% of your maximum mana.

name: Enlightened

name: Eureka
description: When a spell consumes Clearcasting, its damage is increased by 20%.

name: Expanded Mind

Casting Arcane Blast or Arcane Pulse grants 2 stacks of Arcane Salvo.

Casting Arcane Orb grants 1 stack of Arcane Salvo.

Casting Prismatic Bolt grants 4 stacks of Arcane Salvo.

name: Explosive Potential
description: After casting Arcane Surge, your next Blink will cause a Blast Wave at your previous location, dealing 225 Fire damage, knocking enemies back 8 yds, and slowing them by 70% for 6 sec.

name: Flow of Time

 Meteorite

name: Improved Spellsteal
